_doc: Imported from Vibe-Calculators/.appliance/manifest.json (upstream commit on main, 2026-05-05). Schema-conformant against console/manifest.schema.json without translation. SSO: mirrors Vibe-Calculators/.appliance/manifest.json (requires identity, sso block). Its break-glass command runs the distroless image's own node binary — the generic `npx vibe-auth` default does not exist there, which is why provisioning failed on the LAN box.
description: TValue-grade time-value-of-money calculations and a tax-advisory calculator suite for CPA firms.

optional.name: VIBE_APP_SUBDOMAIN
optional.doc: Operator override for this app's subdomain label. Empty = the manifest default. Consumed by the appliance routing (Caddy vhost + Cloudflare Tunnel CNAME/ingress) when DOMAIN_ROUTING_MODE=subdomain-per-app; ignored in single-host mode. Single DNS label — lowercase letters, digits, dashes, no dots.

ui.label: Subdomain
ui.helpText: The <subdomain> in <subdomain>.<your-domain> for this app when routing is 'subdomain per app' (see Network settings). Leave blank to use the built-in default. Lowercase letters, digits, and dashes; no dots. Saving re-renders routing and re-provisions the Cloudflare Tunnel; the app briefly restarts.

optional.name: VIBE_KMS_KEY
optional.doc: AES-256-GCM key (32 bytes, base64) used to encrypt the per-firm Anthropic API key at rest. Aliased to the appliance-wide ENCRYPTION_KEY.

optional.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
optional.doc: Claude API key for AI-assisted loan-agreement extraction (Phase 23). Inherited from appliance.env unless overridden per-app.

ui.label: Anthropic API key
ui.helpText: Powers AI-assisted loan-agreement extraction. The same key is used appliance-wide unless overridden per-app.

optional.name: VIBE_AFR_FEED_URL
optional.doc: IRS AFR feed URL. Defaults to the appliance-wide value.

firstLogin.note: Default admin baked into the upstream calculators image. The app forces a password rotation on first login. If these credentials are rejected, the seed never ran — re-enable the app from the admin Apps tab to retry.
